headline: Approved July 28th draft minutes; police chief presented data on arrests, tickets, and use of force.
summary: A Ward 5 resident spoke during public forum and urged working with the Public Safety Council. Commendations were received for several officers and staff, and a dangerous dog hearing for "Moose" is set for August 31st.
decisions: Approved the draft minutes from July 28th, 2026.

plain_text:
Police Commission  
Tuesday, August 25th, 2026 
Remote via Zoom and In-person in Contois Auditorium, City Hall 
Burlington, Vermont 
DRAFT MINUTES 
 
Members Present: Chair Finneran, Commissioner Ginorio, Commissioner Paul, Commissioner 
V on Hermann 
Members Online: Commissioner Fast 
Staff Present: Interim Chief Burke in-person, Data Analyst Jeff Nicholson online, Command 
Staff Assistant (BPD) Shibe Couchman online.  
 
1. Agenda  
1.1. Call to Order 
Meeting called to order at 6:00 pm by Chair Finneran.  
 
1.2. Roll Call and Determination of Quorum 
Required quorum present.  
 
1.3. Motions for Additions or Modifications to Agenda (Time Limited: 15 Minutes) 
No modifications made.  
 
2. Adopt Minutes 
2.1. Motion to Adopt Draft Minutes from July 28th, 2026 
Commissioner Ginorio moves, Commissioner Paul seconds. Minutes approved and adopted.  
 
3. Public Forum (Time Limited: 10 Minutes) 
3.1. The Public is Invited to Address the Commission 
Sam Donnelly from Ward 5 gave words of appreciation and encouraged the Commission to work 
with Public Safety Council.  
 
4. Police Department Business 
4.1. Chief’s Report 
Chief Burke and Jeff Nicholson present and explain data on incidents, arrests, tickets / warnings, 
distribution of incidents, officer workload, and use of force follow up.  
 
5. Commission Business 
5.1. Reports from all committees 
Complaints – To meet at the conclusion of the monthly meeting 
Animal Control – Dangerous dog hearing for “Moose” on August 31st 
 
6. Commendations 
6.1. Received commendations 
Commendations received regarding Cpl Gonzalez, Cpl Moran, Officer Bartlett, Cpl Montalvo, 
CAIP manager Wageling, and an entire Department commendation from Mayor Mulvaney-
Stanak.
7. Announcement of Next Meeting Date – 9/22/2026 
 
8. Adjournment  
8.1. Meeting adjourned at 6:56pm
